replaced: Let $I$ be finite, $w_i>0$, $p>0$, and $\rho\in\bbr$. Define $G(f)=\sum_iw_i|f_i|^p$ and $F(f)=\rho^2\sum_iw_if_i^2+(1-\rho^2)(\sum_iw_if_i)^2$. If $G(f)=1$ implies $F(f)\le1$ for every real vector $f$, then $F(f)\le G(f)^{2/p}$ for every $f$.
